title: Framework Control
description: A specific control or requirement drawn from a named governance framework, regulation, or standard (e.g. NIST AI RMF, ISO/IEC 42001, EU AI Act). Controls give decisions and patterns a mapping back to recognised external frameworks.

framework_name.description: The governance framework or standard this control belongs to (e.g. 'NIST AI RMF', 'ISO/IEC 42001', 'EU AI Act').

control_reference.description: The framework's own identifier for this control (e.g. 'MEASURE 2.11', 'Annex III').

control_text.description: The control's requirement, quoted or faithfully paraphrased from the source framework.

control_family.description: The grouping or category this control sits within (e.g. 'Measure', 'Govern').
